How it works

  1. Pick a time

    Choose a slot that suits your time zone. You get a confirmation and a video link straight away.

  2. Share your context

    Send a few lines on your background, the role you want and what's blocking you.

  3. Leave with a plan

    Every session ends with written action points you can start on that week.

Booking questions

What happens after I book?

You receive a calendar confirmation with a video call link. Before the session, send a short note on your background and what you want to get out of it so the time goes on your real problem.

How do I pay for a coaching session?

After choosing your time, pay AED 400 through a secure Ziina payment page by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Your booking is confirmed as soon as the payment is received. The free consultation needs no payment.

Can I reschedule?

Yes. Use the reschedule link in your booking confirmation, or contact us on WhatsApp.
